name: garage-door-asap-demos
description: Two homepage redesign demos for Garage Door ASAP Service (Tailwind CSS v4)

scripts.build:1: node scripts/inline-assets.mjs demo-1-night-shift --strip && tailwindcss -i demo-1-night-shift/src/input.css -o demo-1-night-shift/styles.css --minify && node scripts/inline-assets.mjs demo-1-night-shift
scripts.build:2: node scripts/inline-assets.mjs demo-2-daylight --strip && tailwindcss -i demo-2-daylight/src/input.css -o demo-2-daylight/styles.css --minify && node scripts/inline-assets.mjs demo-2-daylight
scripts.build: npm run build:1 && npm run build:2
scripts.dev:1: node scripts/inline-assets.mjs demo-1-night-shift --strip && tailwindcss -i demo-1-night-shift/src/input.css -o demo-1-night-shift/styles.css --watch
scripts.dev:2: node scripts/inline-assets.mjs demo-2-daylight --strip && tailwindcss -i demo-2-daylight/src/input.css -o demo-2-daylight/styles.css --watch
